summary: Gave HTTP 409 a hint line in classifyAPIErrorOnly and removed an empty-bodied if branch.
reason: 409 was the only status in classifyAPIErrorOnly with no hint, while internal/mcp/tools.go already rendered the same status as 'already exists (no-op)' -- the CLI and MCP surfaces of one binary disagreed.
